description: Source code for M3U playlist parser in Android's stagefright media framework, handling parsing of media playlists, media groups, and related metadata.

classes.name: M3UParser::MediaGroup
classes.description: Represents a media group (audio, video, subtitles, closed captions) within an M3U playlist, managing media items and track selection.

methods.name: M3UParser::MediaGroup::addMedia
methods.description: Adds a media item with specified name, URI, language, and flags to the media group.

methods.name: M3UParser::MediaGroup::pickRandomMediaItems
methods.description: Selects a media item randomly or based on properties for the media group.

methods.name: M3UParser::MediaGroup::selectTrack
methods.description: Selects or unselects a specific track within the media group.

methods.name: M3UParser::MediaGroup::countTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of media items (tracks) in the group.

methods.name: M3UParser::MediaGroup::getTrackInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a specific track in the group.

methods.name: M3UParser::parse
methods.description: Parses the M3U playlist data, extracting playlist properties, media items, and metadata.

methods.name: M3UParser::parseMetaData
methods.description: Parses metadata lines such as target duration and media sequence.

methods.name: M3UParser::parseMetaDataDuration
methods.description: Parses duration metadata from playlist lines.

methods.name: M3UParser::parseStreamInf
methods.description: Parses stream information lines, extracting attributes like bandwidth, codecs, resolution, and media groups.

methods.name: M3UParser::parseCipherInfo
methods.description: Parses cipher information lines for encrypted streams.

methods.name: M3UParser::parseByteRange
methods.description: Parses byte range specifications for media segments.

methods.name: M3UParser::parseMedia
methods.description: Parses media group lines, extracting media attributes and adding them to media groups.

methods.name: MakeURL
methods.description: Constructs a full URL from a base URL and a relative or absolute URL.
